title: 1997 response to Bringing Them Home — repair after forcible child removal

decision_cutoff.date_or_period: 1997, after publication of Bringing Them Home
decision_cutoff.definition: Australian governments' response to the National Inquiry's findings and recommendations concerning forcible removal of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander children.

sources.citation: Australian Human Rights Commission, Bringing Them Home — Reparation recommendations
sources.use_note: Sets out the Inquiry's reparation framework including acknowledgement/apology, guarantees against repetition, restitution, rehabilitation and monetary compensation.

sources.citation: Australian Human Rights Commission, Bringing Them Home recommendations on records, family tracing and reunion
sources.use_note: Supports records access, family tracing and reunion needs.

sources.citation: Australian Human Rights Commission, Bringing Them Home — The Effects
sources.use_note: Documents family, cultural, psychological and intergenerational harms.

sources.citation: Parliament of Australia, National Apology to the Stolen Generations, 13 February 2008
sources.use_note: Reveal source documenting the later national apology.

sources.citation: National Indigenous Australians Agency, Territories Stolen Generations Redress Scheme
sources.use_note: Reveal source documenting later Commonwealth redress for eligible survivors removed in the Northern Territory, ACT and Jervis Bay Territory.
